data_quality.notes: Born 12 Jul 2005. Signed with Auckland FC from Wellington Olympic (NZ National League), earning his first crack at professional football per a Stuff.co.nz feature. In his final domestic season before turning pro he scored 20 goals in 30 games including a 4-goal game against Waterside Karori and an extra-time winner in the National League Grand Final; won the Chatham Cup twice with Wellington Olympic, including a Player-of-the-Match display (goal + 2 assists) in one final. These are domestic amateur/semi-pro league stats, not A-League Men professional statistics, and are labelled accordingly in stats_2025_26.competition.
